_comment: Frozen capability-release closure for the prod swarm release (capability_release_mode :strict). Loaded by SwarmNode.ReleaseClosure.load!/3 from config/runtime.exs; its frozen digest is pinned by ASH_A2A_CAPABILITY_RELEASE_DIGEST, and the court standing evidence backing release is resolved offline from ASH_A2A_STANDING_ARTIFACTS_DIR (rel/overlays/standing/, vendored byte-identically from the ash_a2a checkout's real receipts/courts/sa2a/<sha>/ artifacts). Only skills listed here, with an admitted CONFORMANT court receipt at the exact declared subject_revision, may be advertised or dispatched.
